data.summary: The property management company Hausverwaltung Beispieldach & Partner informs the tenant that a remaining €340.00 of the November 2026 rent and the €186.42 operating-cost (Betriebskosten) back-payment for 2025 are still outstanding, totalling €526.42, and asks for payment by 7 December 2026.
data.explanation: Your landlord's property manager says you still owe part of November's rent plus the leftover operating-cost settlement for 2025, €526.42 in total. They ask you to transfer this by 7 December 2026, and mention that an installment plan is possible if you contact them. There is no mention yet of late fees or legal steps, but unpaid rent arrears can eventually put your tenancy at risk, so it's best to pay or contact them before the date. If you think the amount is wrong, check your rent account and the 2025 operating-cost statement, and consider getting advice (e.g. from a tenants' association) if you disagree.
